title: 趋势 B058（风险平价）+ 资金费套利 Book A + 闲置资金生息：前向影子观察

holdout_2025-01-09_2026-09-30.verdict: not a pass (excess CI spans 0; post-hoc combination)

source_research.selection_note: post-hoc combination of research2 artefacts (B058 was the train-selected family-② pick, Book A pre-fixed since 2024-09, idle yield a sensitivity) -> only a forward test can count

trend.pnl_price: perp close per the AUU market store (spot-close proxy, same as trend_tsmom_v1 paper); funding from the store, longs pay

carry.bars: daily: spot close (store), perp close + high (exchange public 1d klines), funding = sum of the day's settlements (store)

idle.base: trend sleeve capital not held in positions: max(0, 1 - gross held)
idle.source: constant 3m T-bill 3.99% (AUU stats.TBILL, as research2 stage3 cash_yield); sUSDS ~3.6% noted as the realistic on-chain alternative

combine.rebalance: close of the first UTC day of each month
combine.zero_vol_rule: a sleeve whose trailing 60d vol is <= zero_vol gets weight 1 (inverse-vol limit; e.g. a flat trend sleeve earning only idle yield); both zero -> fallback

gate.statistic: annualised mean daily return minus T-bill (stats.summarize excess_ci)
gate.ci: 95% moving-block bootstrap, block 20 days, 2000 resamples, StdRng(7)
gate.pass: excess_ci_lo > 0 and no abort condition fired
gate.sample: inception day (entry costs) + the next 180 UTC days
